name: 存储 / NFS Cache 四步创建 / 节点例外、真实试挂、创建后挂载与缓存预算收敛、刷新回读
scope: Single targeted contract for creating one nfs_cache storage on one local node; not a storage-type or page completion claim
command_note: Requires a reachable NFSv4.2 export that allows root writes (host:/path); the case fills that value into the real form and does not create or stop the export. There is no default that can run without one.
identity: admin browser; one real agent (driver=none) enrolled through the real nodes API and run with sudo -n
fixture: isolated server and fresh SQLite, real Chrome, real agent over WS, a caller-owned NFSv4.2 export allowing root writes (gated by mount.nfs4 and a TCP connection to port 2049 before the run counts); every storage path sits under the isolated server's storage root; the default local storage is moved there through the real API before the browser flow, although the agent may report its own models directory for that storage; fixture setup sets reserve_free_bytes=1048576 through the real storage settings API so this empty-cache scenario does not depend on the workstation having the production default disk reserve free

execution_evidence.reason: The trial mount reports readable, writable and NFS version 4.2 without leaving the final mount. After create the kernel shows exactly one mount at the requested path whose type is nfs4, source equals the export and options contain vers=4.2; the probe's total equals statvfs of that mount; a file round-trips through it. The agent creates only the node override cache directory, and the settled cache total equals statvfs of that directory, with available bytes within 256 MiB of statvfs, and the budget converges to satisfied. The report records cache_capacity_source_distinct: distinguishing mount capacity from cache-disk capacity requires those filesystems to differ.

cleanup: Ownership of the storage is registered from the 201 response before any assertion. Cleanup runs in reverse order as independently guarded stages: browser trace/context/browser, the agent (TERM then KILL, only while /proc/<pid>/cmdline still names this run's agent state), the mount (fallback sudo umount), the server and the log copies. Each stage's outcome is in cleanup_stages; remaining_resources keeps the storage, mount and processes that were not observed gone with a scoped reclaim command, and any non-ok stage withdraws PASS. The agent writes its state (including its node token) and the cache directories as root (root_owned_paths); remove only this run directory with sudo after diagnosis (7 days). The export itself is owned and torn down by the caller. Failure-path self-tests: test_storage_cache_cleanup.py (make test-e2e-storage-nfs-cache-fixture). The export marker is registered before writing, removed and observed absent independently, and retained as an export-file residual on failure; NFS file commands and fallback unmount have deadlines. Mountinfo paths are decoded before ownership checks. NFS statvfs, file I/O and fallback umount use a root GNU timeout process group, not a timeout on sudo alone. Root command PID/PGID remains in the ledger while a process is still active; an outstanding writer prevents marker ownership from being cleared. A real sudo delayed-writer self-test verifies that the watchdog leaves no running writer.
artifact: secrets/e2e/<runId>/report.json with source SHA/working-tree state, server/agent/test/helper/manifest digests, locale, browser version, probe and create bodies, independent GETs, mountinfo, settled node cache, cleanup observations, remaining_resources, redacted trace, server and agent logs; browser page/console/HTTP errors are recorded and unexpected errors fail the case; target branch and SHA are recorded
result: NOT_RUN until a matching report.json records PASS with all required evidence, source and binary identity, all cleanup stages ok and no remaining resources
